name: Open Way
tag: Mosque + prayer path / an open invitation
summary: A generous mosque doorway opens onto a warm path, with a square minaret balancing the domed hall.
why: The door and dome share one centerline. The gold path begins directly at the threshold, widening toward the viewer with matching perspective edges. The minaret joins the hall at the same foundation and carries an attached copper cornice.
risk: The path emphasizes arrival and welcome; it does not depict a measured Qibla bearing. The deliberately asymmetric tower balances the broad entrance.
theme: Mosque + prayer path / an open invitation
reasonToChoose: You want the mark to express a gentle invitation to prayer.
